verdict.rationale: Thoropass is a SaaS compliance platform, so letting customers choose their data storage region is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents region selection or data-residency options. The GDPR framework support and IP allowlisting docs concern compliance content and network access, not where Thoropass stores customer data, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
